summary.text: Mike Hodges, a Republican, was elected to the Georgia State Senate's 3rd District in 2022 and was sworn in on January 9, 2023.

paragraphs.text: He is a Brunswick native with a BBA in Banking and Finance from the University of Georgia's Terry College of Business.

He is retired from banking and finance; he was a founder of the First Bank of Brunswick, became its CEO in 1996, and later served as president of the Georgia Southeast Coastal Market for Ameris Bancorp.
